goal: Play a full round: put out fires, rescue everyone, refill water
summary: The playtester tried the Axe and Extinguisher gear racks in the lobby, then the Mission Board, and every prompt interaction returned 'held, not triggered'. The round never started (the playtester reported RoundState stayed Lobby), so fires, rescues and refilling were never tested. The probe showed no server errors.

bugs.title: Mission Board 'Pick a call' prompt never triggers, so the round cannot start
bugs.evidence: Step 6: interact on Lobby.MissionBoard at about 7.8 studs (range 16, in range) returned 'held, not triggered'. Step 7: an explicit E key press with a 0.5s hold returned the same result. The playtester reported RoundState stayed Lobby. The session ended at step 8 with no round started.

bugs.title: Gear Rack prompts (Grab Axe / Grab Extinguisher) never trigger; backpack stays empty
bugs.evidence: Step 1: GearRack1 'Grab Axe' at about 8 studs returned 'held, not triggered'. Step 3: the same result after walking to within about 3 studs. Step 4: GearRack2 'Grab Extinguisher' returned the same result. The playtesters reported the backpack still empty and the HUD showing 'empty hands'. No tool was ever granted.

bugs.title: ProximityPrompts may be failing globally in the lobby (possible harness issue)
bugs.evidence: All three distinct prompts (GearRack1, GearRack2, MissionBoard) failed identically at steps 1-7, with hold 0 and in range. The probe shows no errors and only 1 warning, so the cause is unclear. It could be a client-side prompt or input problem, or a Studio simulation limitation. A developer should check whether the prompt Triggered handlers fire at all.
